api.notes: Keys joined with `+`; `mod` resolves by platform; aliases esc and return; `plus` for a literal +.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host (class, style), ::part(base) and ::part(key).
The element itself is the handle; the group is reachable as part "base".

hooks.notes: kbd/kbd.keys.ts (folder-private): client hints first, then navigator.platform, false on the server.

differences.text: The role="img" and computed aria-label live on the inner part="base" group, not the host: a host role or aria-label cannot replace the computed name (upstream lets neither win either, by spreading them before the computed props). The host itself has no role.

Apple platform detection runs when the element connects (client only), so a server-rendered or not yet upgraded shortcut shows the non-Apple form first, like upstream's useSyncExternalStore server snapshot.
The badge surface is --color-background-muted (tecton-astryx components.ts `kbd`) instead of --color-neutral; the 2px bottom edge stays --color-border-emphasized as decorative depth (D-013 Q-05).
Forced colours give each key a ButtonBorder edge (backgrounds are dropped there).
The spoken key names (Control, Shift, Up arrow, Command) are English constants, as upstream; an i18n catalog for them is not part of the upstream message set, so they are not localised yet.

core.kbd.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] role=img and spoken name on an inner element in the same root; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts base and key; [mwg:custom-elements] client-only detection in connectedCallback.
